description:
VectorTemplate represents a template for assembling OCM components into an OCM component
that represents a vector.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: spec defines the desired state of VectorTemplate

base.description: Base represents an optional base component version to build upon.

components.description: Components lists the components to be included in the vector.

items.description:
Component defines a component of a VectorTemplate.
A struct is used for future expansion.

credentials.description:
Credentials supplies credentials for OCM repositories
and signing/verification key material.

ocm.description:
OCMCredentials lists Secrets/ConfigMaps holding `.ocmconfig` or
`.dockerconfigjson` data. All references are same-namespace.

items.description:
CredentialRef references a Secret or ConfigMap in the same namespace
as the holding resource.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: at least one credential surface must be set

reconcileInterval.description:
ReconcileInterval defines how often the assembly controller should check for drift.
If not set, the controller's default reconcile interval will be used.

signVector.description:
SignVector lists signatures the controller produces on the emitted
vector. Absence disables signing.

items.description:
Signature pins parameters of one named signature on a component
descriptor. Used both for verification (matched against the fetched
descriptor) and for signing (overrides defaults of the emitted
signature).

uploadTarget.description: UploadTarget defines the target OCM component where the assembled vector will be uploaded.

verifyArtifacts.description:
VerifyArtifacts lists candidate signatures evaluated against every
artifact pulled into the assembly. Absence disables artifact
verification.

policy.description:
Policy selects how the signatures list combines into a verdict.
AllOf — every listed signature must verify.
AnyOf — at least one listed signature must verify.

descriptor. Used both for verification (matched against the fetched
descriptor) and for signing (overrides defaults of the emitted
signature).

verifyVector.description:
VerifyVector lists candidate signatures evaluated against any
vector the assembly fetches (base or pre-existing upload target).
Absence disables vector verification.
